::: {.content-visible when-format="pdf"}
# *Overview* {-}
:::

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
![](img/logo_tm.png "Stan Logo"){width=225 .column-margin .d-none .d-md-block}
:::


This is the official user's guide for [Stan](https://mc-stan.org/).  It provides example
models and programming techniques for coding statistical models in Stan. It does *not*
provide a guide to installing or using any of the interfaces required to use Stan.

- <i>Introduction</i>: Outline of the Stan project's scope and
documentation, plus an outline of how Stan works.

- <i>Example Models</i>: Stan code and discussions for several important classes
of models.

- <i>Programming Techniques</i>: A discussion of general Stan
programming techniques that are not tied to any particular model.

- <i>Posterior Inference and Model Checking</i>: An overview of
algorithms for calibration and model checking that require multiple
runs of Stan.

- <i>Appendices</i> The appendices provide an introduction to the
  `stanc3` compiler used in the various interfaces to Stan, a style
  guide, and advice for users of BUGS and JAGS.

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
[Download the pdf version of this manual](https://mc-stan.org/docs/{{< env STAN_DOCS_VERSION_PATH >}}/stan-users-guide-{{< env STAN_DOCS_VERSION_PATH >}}.pdf).
:::
